# Vendored libraries (offline)

Copied into this folder so the page runs with no network and no CDN.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | pdfjs-dist | 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | pdf-lib | 1.17.1 | MIT |

To update, install the new version in a scratch folder and copy the same three files here.
